source: Tools/LevelDesign/anchor_plans/design_warrens_v6.py (Warrens v6 Kitchen first: v5 The Well + the r02 proposal-i expansion, 2026-10-20)
units: metres; costCm is the walk cost in centimetres

rooms.label: Root Grotto
rooms.note: New west extension, not a re-skin of the Cistern. Dry perimeter circulation around an explicit floor-founded harvest shelf and central mineral divider; one shelf has a short exposed approach and a full-width safe bypass. Keep a continuous 3 m pack route. No water is added in this first prototype. Shell opens from the 2.2 m entry to 4 m clear height; exact irregular roof is a later blockout target.

rooms.label: Root Listener's Recess
rooms.note: Small new standing discovery pocket reached by one optional 1.5 x 1.3 m packless squeeze. A fixed environmental find and view into root strata; no required ingredient, new exit, or always-active loot promise.

rooms.label: Old Service Spiral
rooms.note: A small new vertical service room with its main floor at -2.5. Eighteen supported spiral treads climb 270 degrees to a separate upper landing at 0. The upper approach crosses on an explicit supported deck; no flat upper floor bypasses the stair.
